notes.title: Gamescom & Indie Arena Booth: Q & A session on Discord
notes.content:
We're looking forward to being part of this year's Gamescom and Indie Arena Booth! To seize the opportunity, we will be hosting a Q & A session on [url=http://discord.gg/mixtvision][b]Discord[/b][/url] on [b]August 28, 3pm CEST / 6am PDT[/b]. Interrogate us about "Interrogation: You will be deceived" - we're looking forward to chatting with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474641/02779fb3588f0bcff48ab13d0e81aef6edb73932.jpg[/img]

[b]About the game:[/b]

As a police detective tasked with bringing down a dangerous terrorist group, you fight on two fronts: interrogating suspects & managing your team and its reputation. With time running out, how far will you go to stop these criminals? Manipulation, threats or even torture? Does the end justify the means?
[list][*] Explore deep and increasingly difficult conversational puzzles to get to the bottom of a terrifying conspiracy
[*] Show your management skills balancing your cases, team, budget and the police force’s relationship with the public
[*] Reach one of multiple world-defining endings - where will your choices lead you?
[*] Meet over 35 complex and realistic characters
[*] Immerse yourself in the expressive noir art based on real actor footage and atmospheric music
[/list]

[b]Investigate further:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016770/Interrogation_You_will_be_deceived/

... and visit our booth at the [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth[/url]!

notes.title: Soundtrack out now
notes.content:
Noir, gritty, immersive and serious: All of Interrogation’s art and sound is built around a feeling of tension. The almost-monochrome art and carefully hand-drawn rotoscoped animations play a vital role in creating this feeling. 

The game's heavy but smooth music inspired by classic noir movies, however, supports and amplifes this venture. It conveys the imminent danger that the player is working against as well as the serious nature of the challenge and brings the foreboding atmosphere to its fullest.

Interrogation's Original Soundtrack, composed by Dexi Antoniu, features 9 tracks. Each of them has been specially crafted to immerse the player in the mistery of a particular investigation while leaving enough room for them to think and focus. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474641/32a251eb72635008925852398f1d24927ab24c97.jpg[/img]

Get the OST:

[url=https://soundcloud.com/mixtvision/wheat-chaff/s-UzpCjkbaecp]Listen to a sample track on Soundcloud.[/url]

notes.title: Visual Novel Mode Update & flash sale!
notes.content:
Being a detective is hard work. You can't just spend all day at your computer. So we are bringing Interrogation to mobile! Grab it now on [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/interrogation-deceived/id1495159910]iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mixtvision.interrogation]Android[/url].
We are also introducing the [i]all new Visual Novel Mode[/i] on all platforms!

This new mode is a more relaxed way to experience the story of Interrogation. It lets you follow the thrilling plot by guiding you through the dialogue for the most part. You still get to make moral decisions, but there is no game over. The best of both worlds!

Last but not least we have a little something special: 
We know that a lot of us are spending more time at home these days, so we partnered with our friends at FAR: Lone Sails for a flash sale starting 10am PST to help pass the time. We just came out with our brand new Visual Novel mode & FAR dropped its price lower than ever before - stay safe and we hope you enjoy the games!

You can get FAR here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/

Be safe out there, detective!
[i]- Team Interrogation[/i]

notes.title: Interrogation: You will be deceived out now for PC, Mac and Linux
notes.content:
Put your interrogation skills to the test now and get to the bottom of a terrifying conspiracy!

[previewyoutube=X7yFCXGFSGc;full][/previewyoutube]

Interrogation has grown and changed a lot over the past couple of years and along with it our vision here at Critique Gaming: we think that games have the ability to make the world a better place in small ways that could accumulate to significant impact. 

We hope for Interrogation to leave a lasting impression with everyone who plays it, to broaden perspectives and being entertaining at the same time.

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
A heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who supported us, spread the word about the game, or shared their thoughts and feelings about it!			 				
 			 				
If you buy Interrogation and have a good time with it, please consider leaving a review. It would help a lot!

You can also tell your favorite YouTubers, Twitch streamers, podcasters, bloggers, or news outlets about it, or add tags on our Steam page, so the game will be better represented!

If you want to share your feedback, ideas and/or love with us, please send us an email, leave a comment on our Steam page or contact us via Twitter or Facebook.

Team [i]Interrogation: You will be deceived[/i]
